description: Publish gate for learned carrier format specs (ADR 0007 as amended in the 06/06b reviews). A spec learned from a document is published only when its replay on that document has 0 hard rule failures, no unmapped headers, no normalization or lint issues, a claim number on every claim row, and then either (a) every required field present and a printed subtotal or grand total reconciling (R-10/R-12), or (b) for spreadsheets only, no printed total contradicting the rows, at least minCoverage of the required fields present, and the carrier named by the submission. Required-field semantics: document.* present; period.* present on every policy period; claim.* present on at least one claim (alwaysRequired claim fields on every claim). Values supplied by the submission context (lineage extractor 'context') count as present: conditionalFromContext lists the fields a spreadsheet may take from the context instead of printing them. Code: LossRun.Learning.LearnGate (reads this file; never the other way round).

summaryOnly.description: ADR 0017: a summary-only loss run (every policy period summary-only) has no claim rows, so the claim fields and R-10/R-12 do not apply. It is published only with the document fields, a printed total incurred on every period row, a label or date or policy number on every period, the period rows reconciling to a printed grand total (R-26), and every amount read covered by such a check (everyAmountChecked).
summaryOnly.everyAmountCheckedDescription: Brief 22 Answers 6: every money amount the summary-only replay reads (period subtotals and report totals: indemnity, medical, expense, total, recoveries) must be checked by a passing printed-total rule (R-26 for its component and measure). An amount no total checks is reported as an issue and the spec is not published. Recoveries are in no totals rule, so a summary-only spec that reads them routes to review. It is the rule that would have stopped the brief 22 wrong publish (two analysis columns read as recoveries) before the mapped-and-ignored lint existed; both stay.

exemplars.description: Brief 30 item 19: a drift repair (delta, or the learn it escalates to) must also verify on the format's last N accepted documents, not only on the document that drifted (carrier-format-memory.md: multi-exemplar verification). The first learn of a format has none.
